newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS details Elektrowatt share price.
newsitem.headline: CS details Elektrowatt share price.

text.p: Credit Suisse said a due diligence study by a consortium buying the energy activities of Elektrowatt had reconfirmed an earlier price set at 265 Swiss francs per share.
A second study on the industrial activities of Elektrowatt, which will be sold to Siemens AG, is expected to be completed in April, CS said.

"The due diligence assessment by the consortium buying the energy section is now complete; no price adjustment is necessary. The agreed price in respect of the energy section thus remains unchanged at 265 francs per share," CS said.

Elektrowatt's energy activies will be taken over by a consortium of Swiss and German power companies: Nordostschweizerische Kraftwerke (NOK), Bayernwerk, Badenwerk and Energieversorgung Schwaben. CS Group also retains a stake.
CS Group currently has a 44.9 percent stake in Elektrowatt.
CS, one of Switzerland's largest banking and financial concerns, announced plans to restructure Elektrowatt and divest most of its holdings in the energy and industrial firm last year.
